description: The bundled main window ships the internal-alpha product surface: transcript-alpha capture commands, retained-meeting Library, exact transcript/title search, content-free voice-profile status, the content-free enrolment evidence listing with its honest recording boundary, explicit preserve-first legacy-profile migration, separately confirmed profile reset, and the reviewed one-meeting audio-deletion boundary. It has no profile activation, enrollment mutation, note generation, generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, or remote-origin permission.
